subtasks: Pour the liquid from the turquoise bottle into the white bowl on the right. Allow the liquid to settle and return the bottle upright.
Return the emptied turquoise bottle upright to its original spot on the left of the violet bottle and release it there.
Pour the liquid from the center violet bottle into the brown bowl on the left. Let the liquid settle and return the violet bottle upright to the table.

Use the right arm to pour the liquid from the red bottle on the right into the black bowl in the center. Let the liquid settle, return the bottle upright to the table, then open both grippers and return both arms home.
Return the red bottle upright to its starting area on the table, release it, then fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
